profile.headline: Software Engineer at THALES RAYTHEON Systems
profile.summary:
Highly talented, proactive and diligent engineer with over 15 years of experience in designing and developing complex air defense and communications applications. Results-driven, customer-focused, detail-oriented and creative thinker. Proven track record for customer support, mentoring and realizing development cost savings backed by numerous awards and accomplishments.

Languages:		     	Java/Java EE/Swing, C, C++, Ada, Motif, X-Windows, XML, UML, SQL
Frameworks/ToolKits:      Solipsys TDF, OpenMap, Apache Velocity Engine, Junit
Operating Systems:	 Linux, UNIX, Windows, VAX/VMS
Tools:	                         ClearCase, ClearQuest, Klocwork, Apache Ant/Maven, DOORS
Environments/IDEs:	 NetBeans, Eclipse, Rational Apex
Design Methods:  		 OOD, OO Design Patterns, Plugin Architecture, Structured Design
DoD Secret Clearance:  	 Active

positions.title: Software Engineer for Command View Missions Systems
positions.description:
Technical Skills
•	Developed and maintained software for a Command View ® Missions Solutions product line that optimizes mission solutions for Civil, Joint, Air Force, Army, and Maritime forces. Layered software architecture design using the JBOSS application server, Java EE, Java Swing and Oracle database.
•	Designed, developed and tested new capabilities of recording, playback and alert processing with less than 1% defects found during integration and system test. Software developed in the business, data access, and presentation (Client) layers requiring new data modeling.
•	Investigated system integration issues in all software architectural layers and achieved appropriate solutions with less than 2% defects found during internal customer approval.
•	Developed software to send and receive external USMTF messages that resulted in zero defects found during integration and system test.
•	Authored design documents using UML standards including use cases, class, sequence and activity diagrams.

Leadership Skills
•	Technical Lead engineer, SCRUM master and developer for a new alert processing framework team of six engineers for five months. Authored and conducted the Functional Quality Test resulting with 0.5% defects. Delivered the capability four weeks ahead of schedule.
•	Rescued a troubled late and running over budget engineering effort for recording and playback capabilities and delivered the functionality on time for the new extended deadline. Acquired SCRUM master role of the 10 member team with 120 man month budget after the original deadline missed.

positions.title: Software Engineer for Sentry Air Defense
positions.description:
Technical Skills
•	Upgraded the United States Air Force Battle Control System (BCS) to replace the aircraft situation display with Solipsys Tactical Display Framework (TDF) which is a scalable, high-performance, geospatial visualization software toolkit written in Java. Using the TDF plugin architecture, implemented additional frameworks and GUI enhancements to render BCS specific displays. 
•	Fixed existing Solipsys TDF problems by overwriting existing Solipsys TDF plugins for a cost savings of 50% of the Solipsys patch purchase price.
•	Maintained and enhanced the Offline Adaptation Data Editor (ADE) written in Java using the Apache Velocity Engine and OpenMap toolkit. Eliminated major roadblock by extending ADE to support the map projection used by BCS for calculating the system coordinate plane.
•	Resolved Problem Reports for fielded systems at 40% of the proposal cost.  Thoroughly tested all fixes to deliver a complete solution with minimized customer feedback or additional Problem Reports written against the same functionality.
•	Completed the design, implementation and integration test of 26 operator commands and eight displays within the aggressive 100 day milestone for BCS Spiral 1 Contract Demonstration which resulted in winning the contract.

Leadership Skills
•	Managed software personnel for solving Problem Reports from the United States Air Force.  Led the integration test effort to ensure the system behaves as the customer expected. While performing these duties, personally resolved a majority of the problems. Delivered software builds on time.

honors.title: Monetary Bonuses
honors.description: Earned multiple monetary bonuses for mentoring and leadership achievements.

honors.title: Outstanding Achievement Award
honors.description: Awarded Outstanding Achievement Award with monetary bonus for software point of contact duties with United States Air Force.
